name: Toggle / Visible Layers
description: Visible Layers product scenario for the Toggle component.

controls.name: label
controls.description: Visible name of the value. Empty content leaves naming to aria-label/aria-labelledby.

controls.name: description
controls.description: Help for entering the value, announced with the focused control.

controls.name: error
controls.description: Validation message; marks the field invalid unless aria-invalid is explicit. Not a live region.

controls.name: labelPosition
controls.description: Label above the control, or at its inline start (stacks when narrow). Defaults to top.

controls.name: items
controls.description: Choices in visual, keyboard and form order; an item with a missing or repeated `value` is skipped.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disables every choice and leaves the value out of FormData.

controls.name: orientation
controls.description: Lays the choices out in a row or a column; without `multiple`, all four arrow keys move between choices.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Names the group when there is no visible label.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: Ids of visible elements that name the group; they take precedence over `label`.

controls.name: name
controls.description: FormData key; a multiple value submits one entry per choice.

controls.name: form
controls.description: Id of the form that submits and resets the value, when it is not an ancestor.

controls.name: required
controls.description: Blocks form submission until a choice is selected and marks the group required; a group with no enabled choice never blocks.

controls.name: autoFocus
controls.description: Focuses the selected enabled choice, or the first enabled one, on mount.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Shared outer spacing around each choice; toggling it keeps DOM and focus.

controls.name: multiple
controls.description: Lets the user press any number of choices, and makes the value a `string[]` instead of `string | null`.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Selected key, or keys with `multiple`; keys missing from `items` select nothing until they appear.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.description: Selection on mount, restored by form reset; same shape as `value`.
